Hi, I’m new here, so apologies if this is the wrong channel.. I was looking at composition of primitive Pythagorean triples and ended up with two identities... - gcd(x,y) = gcd(y,q^2)
gcd(x,y) = gcd(y,q)^2 x = ac-bd, y = ad+bc, q = gcd(m,n), uz a²+b²=m², c²+d²=n². I have Lean 4 proofs for these. iam not claiming novelty; I want to know whether this already exists in mathlib or in a more general form. .. If not, would a small lemma like this be useful for mathlib? https://github.com/VolMax-Studio/primitive-composition-square-content-s1 My English is not perfect and I’m new to Lean community, so please correct me if I’m asking this in the wrong place. Thank you..
